Questions and answers

What is 容错自动着陆模式?

In this glossary, 容错自动着陆模式 refers to: Autoland logic able to complete flare, touchdown and rollout after any single-component failure below alert height.

How is 容错自动着陆模式 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "已启用容错自动着陆模式；即使在警戒高度以下出现故障，飞机仍会保持自动联结并完成着陆滑跑。"

Definition

Autoland logic able to complete flare, touchdown and rollout after any single-component failure below alert height.

Operational example

Fail-operational autoland mode armed; aircraft will remain coupled and roll out automatically even after system fault below alert height.

Localized term

容错自动着陆模式
